final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS average_doubles FROM player AS p JOIN batting_postseason AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, average_doubles / (SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages) AS "index" FROM player_averages), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, "index", "index" - AVG("index") OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS index_minus_hand_average FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, "index", index_minus_hand_average FROM compared WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY index_minus_hand_average IS NULL, index_minus_hand_average DESC LIMIT 10
